title: Identity-consistent image generation (the headline deliverable) is NOT functional
evidence: ComfyUI container has only default custom_nodes (example_node.py.example, websocket_image_save.py) — no InstantID/PuLID nodes. `find models/ -iname '*instantid*' -o -iname '*pulid*' -o -iname '*antelope*' -o -iname '*ip-adapter*'` returns nothing. No model weights for InstantID/ControlNet/insightface on disk. All 5 characters have has_body=f (no canonical full-body ref), so generate-consistent returns HTTP 422 'requires a canonical face and full-body reference'.
reproduction_steps: docker compose exec model-comfyui ls /comfyui/custom_nodes  -> only example + websocket
recommended_fix: Install ComfyUI InstantID (or PuLID-Flux) custom nodes + deps (insightface, onnxruntime); download InstantID ip-adapter + ControlNet + antelopev2 weights; add compose mounts for custom_nodes + instantid/controlnet/insightface; generate + promote a canonical full-body per character.

title: Video generation pipeline is non-operational at runtime (orchestrator + all agents stopped, jobs table emptied)
evidence: docker ps shows NO aivideo-orchestrator-1 or aivideo-agent-* containers (only an unrelated ai-home-orchestrator from a different project). `SELECT count(*) FROM jobs` = 0 (table emptied in a prior turn). Video DAG cannot run.
recommended_fix: Intentional per operator (moving to 128GB GPU box). To re-enable: docker compose --profile gpu up -d orchestrator agent-*. Not a code defect.

title: upload-reference + moderate endpoints have NO frontend wiring (dead backend capability)
evidence: lib/characters.ts exports uploadReferenceImage() + moderateReferenceImage(), and the backend routes exist (POST .../images/upload-reference, POST .../images/{id}/moderate). `rg uploadReferenceImage|moderateReferenceImage components app` returns ONLY the lib definition — no component calls them. The gated synthetic-attestation upload + moderation flow is unreachable from the UI.
reproduction_steps: rg -n 'uploadReferenceImage|moderateReferenceImage' frontend/components frontend/app  -> no matches outside lib
recommended_fix: Add an Upload-reference control (file picker + synthetic attestation checkbox) and a moderation approve/reject control in CharacterImageLibrary.

title: All recent work is UNCOMMITTED on main (86 changed files; last commit is 'Phase 12')
evidence: git log -1 = '8a54cf1 Phase 12 ...'; git status --porcelain | wc -l = 86. Everything from Phase 21..IG-6 (image pipeline, migrations 0007-0010, lifecycle, clone) is uncommitted working-tree state on the main branch.
recommended_fix: Create a feature branch and commit in reviewable chunks; do not leave multi-phase work uncommitted on main.

title: generate-consistent is blocked for every existing character (no canonical full-body reference set)
evidence: psql: all 5 characters full_body_reference_image_id IS NULL (has_body=f). character_image_service.generate_consistent_character_image raises validation_failed when either canonical ref is missing.
recommended_fix: Generate a full-body candidate (generate-initial), then POST set-full-body-reference to promote it.

title: Mobile portrait 720x1280 published-job evidence no longer exists (jobs deleted)
evidence: Prior claim cited a published 720x1280 job; the jobs table is now empty (count=0). Orientation code exists (_ORIENTATION_DIMS in agents/editor + scene_composer) but the runtime artifact is gone.
reproduction_steps: psql 'SELECT count(*) FROM jobs WHERE orientation=portrait' -> 0
recommended_fix: Re-run a portrait job after the video pipeline is restarted to re-establish evidence.

title: Duplicate /jobs route surface (legacy unprefixed + /api/v1/jobs)
evidence: OpenAPI lists both /jobs/* and /api/v1/jobs/* (main.py includes jobs.router twice: once bare, once prefixed /api/v1). Two public surfaces for the same handlers.
recommended_fix: Deprecate the unprefixed /jobs alias once no client depends on it.

title: character_images.role backfilled to default for pre-existing canonical-face images
evidence: All 6 existing images have role='generated_variation' (the migration 0010 server_default), including the 5 canonical-face references. Role label is therefore semantically inaccurate for older rows.
reproduction_steps: psql 'SELECT role,count(*) FROM character_images GROUP BY role' -> all generated_variation
recommended_fix: One-off data backfill: set role='canonical_face' where id = characters.main_reference_image_id, etc.

title: model-comfyui compose lacks custom_nodes + InstantID/ControlNet/insightface mounts
evidence: compose.dev.yml model-comfyui volumes mount only sdxl-base-1.0, flux, sd35 (ro) + artifacts_data. No custom_nodes mount, no instantid/controlnet/insightface model mounts. InstantID cannot be wired without editing compose.
